messages:
Anna (infra): Heads up — eu3 hosted GPU pool is seeing sustained queued jobs, queue depth peaked ~260 and admitted RPS dropped ~30% around 12:03 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/eu3/pools
CapacityBot: ALERT: eu3-hosted-gpu queue_length > 200 (12:03 UTC) :warning:
Mike L: on it. pulling grafana + k8s events now :eyes:
Rahul: looks like pod churn on nodegroup eu3-gpu-rt-2, OOMKilled spikes at same time, reducing available slots. PromQL I ran:```sum by(pool) (queue_length{region="eu3"}) / sum by(pool) (pool_capacity{region="eu3"})```shows saturation ~0.95
Sophie: is admission_control kicking in? I saw some 429s earlier in hosted logs.
Anna (infra): yes, admission_control threshold hit. We have policy: admit if capacity_util < 0.85. It flipped to deny when backend capacity dropped.
Mike L: repro of events: several long-running requests (large seq len) blocked some GPU slots and autoscaler kept scaling but kube took 90s to schedule. Patch candidate: reduce pod eviction pressure by bumping nodegroup desired temporarily.
Rahul: also batching efficiency collapsed — lots of tiny requests (5-15 tokens) preventing fill. We can try short-term shaper to coalesce small requests. Quick PromQL to see small request share:```sum(rate(requests_total{region="eu3",token_count<20}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{region="eu3"}[5m]))``` ~0.62
Sophie: ops question — if we allocate more reserved capacity for burst, what's cost delta? rough calc? :money_with_wings:
Mike L: rough numbers: +4 GPUs for 1h in eu3 ~= $2.3k/hr (including infra + infra overhead). Cheaper to enable burst from dedicated pool if we can redirect some traffic.
Anna (infra): decision for now: enable temporary override to admission_control to 0.9 to reduce 429s and flip on dedicated-burst routing to drain queue into reserved pool. I'll coordinate with sales/dedicated team if needed.
Oncall-Bot: @oncall assigned to Anna (infra) for the incident (1832000000)
Sophie: can we add a dashboard panel for per-tenant queue depth + small-req ratio? makes it easier to triage next time.
Anna (infra): agreed — Rahul can you add a quick grafana panel? if not, post the panel JSON in thread and I'll wire it.
Rahul: will do. quick panel snippet (Grafana JSON) coming in PR. CLI to bump nodegroup now:```kubectl patch nodegroup eu3-gpu-rt-2 -p '{"spec":{"desired":12}}' --type=merge```
Mike L: after patch, capacity recovered ~6 slots in 70s, admitted RPS back to ~baseline. queue depth trending down.
CapacityBot: RESOLVED: eu3-hosted-gpu queue_length dropped below 100 (12:07 UTC) :white_check_mark:
Anna (infra): follow-ups: 1) add per-tenant queue metric 2) investigate why OOM spike happened (maybe GC or model memory regression) 3) look into short-request shaping and batching heuristics. I'll file tasks and assign.
